summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a notice of board meeting scheduled for August 25, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited quarterly and interim results for the period ended June 30, 2026, and to hold an earnings call. This is a routine earnings-related announcement with no special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative corporate action is described. The filing merely informs shareholders of the upcoming board meeting and results publication. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation; the appropriate classification is None.
